title: App crashes on login
description: Users on iOS 17 report a hard crash right after entering credentials and tapping login.

title: Typo in welcome email
description: 'Wellcome' spelled incorrectly in the onboarding email template sent to new signups.

title: SQL injection vulnerability in search bar
description: Search input field does not sanitize special characters, raw SQL can be injected and returns unexpected data.

title: Dashboard loads slowly with large datasets
description: Analytics dashboard takes 15+ seconds to render when the account has more than 10,000 records.

title: Button misaligned on checkout page
description: The 'Place Order' button visually overlaps with the price summary box on mobile screens under 400px width.

title: Password reset link never arrives
description: Some users report never receiving the password reset email, no error shown on the request form either.

title: Export to CSV produces corrupted file
description: Downloaded CSV opens with garbled characters in Excel for accounts using non-English names.

title: Admin panel accessible without login on staging
description: On the staging server, /admin route loads directly without redirecting to the login page, exposing user data.
